name: 同道堂

sourceConflict.claim: Generic Xianfu entry calls Tongdao a five-bay hard-gable hall
Dedicated Tongdao entry calls it a five-bay yellow-glazed xieshan hall

roof.decision: Dedicated building entry plus visible lower hip returns and upper gable in official photo support this bounded roof-form correction; conflicting generic entry remains recorded
roof.retained: All lower hall meshes, columns, windows, doors, furniture, room and navigation data, plus the original roof-bearing bracket band
roof.limits: Stock low-detail xieshan proportions; dimensions, pitch, exact eave/gable construction, ornament counts/species, bracket carving, colour and photography date remain unverified. Not whole-building or GPU/browser acceptance

windows.unknown: Dimensions, fine lattice repeat, joins, paint, glazing properties and reverse remain unmeasured. Temporary access barriers and closed central doors in source photographs are intentionally not copied.

limits: Actual integrated local mesh + HD albedo/UV and plaque atlas. CPU raster omits WebGL normal maps/PBR/shadows/tone mapping. Source photographs are not copied. No historical, browser, full-building, or F55 acceptance.
